plugins.name: enterprise-search
plugins.description: Search across all of your company's tools in one place. Find anything across email, chat, documents, and wikis without switching between apps.

skills.name: digest
skills.description: Generate a daily or weekly digest of activity across all connected sources. Use when catching up after time away, starting the day and wanting a summary of mentions and action items, or reviewing a week's decisions and document updates grouped by project.
skills.description_zh: 生成全部连接来源的每日或每周活动摘要，整理提及、行动、决策和文档更新并按项目分组。

skills.name: knowledge-synthesis
skills.description: Combines search results from multiple sources into coherent, deduplicated answers with source attribution. Handles confidence scoring based on freshness and authority, and summarizes large result sets effectively.
skills.description_zh: 合并多来源搜索为连贯去重答案，标注来源并按时效和权威评估置信度，汇总大结果集。

skills.name: search-strategy
skills.description: Query decomposition and multi-source search orchestration. Breaks natural language questions into targeted searches per source, translates queries into source-specific syntax, ranks results by relevance, and handles ambiguity and fallback strategies.
skills.description_zh: 拆解自然语言问题为各来源专用搜索，转换查询语法、排序相关性并处理歧义和回退。

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search across all connected sources in one query. Trigger with "find that doc about...", "what did we decide on...", "where was the conversation about...", or when looking for a decision, document, or discussion that could live in chat, email, cloud storage, or a project tracker.
skills.description_zh: 一次搜索全部连接来源，跨聊天、邮件、云存储和项目工具查找决定、文档或讨论。

skills.name: source-management
skills.description: Manages connected MCP sources for enterprise search. Detects available sources, guides users to connect new ones, handles source priority ordering, and manages rate limiting awareness.
skills.description_zh: 管理企业搜索MCP来源，识别可用连接、引导新增、安排优先级并处理限流。

name: enterprise search
summary_zh: 在一处搜索公司的所有工具，无需在应用之间切换，即可通过电子邮件、聊天、文档和 wiki 查找任何内容。
description: Search across all of your company's tools in one place. Find anything across email, chat, documents, and wikis without switching between apps.
requirements: 含 MCP 服务配置：asana、atlassian、gmail、google calendar、guru、notion、slack
evidence_note: 基于包内静态说明；未安装、未运行，作者宣称的效果未验收。
classification_basis: 说明与技能匹配，支持多用途标签
title: Enterprise Search
